summary: N §7.2 W1 in ContentsDialog: quote rows with a non-clickable 48 dp swatch column decided by the DOWN x (InkPager drag-to-page intact), palette recolour via Library.updateQuoteStyle + refreshQuoteHighlights (style passed, last style pref written), 색 바꾸기 in the long-press menu, in-memory style chips [전체 N] [● n] with '인용문 5 / 12', tagged share-all capped at SHARE_MAX_CHARS on an entry boundary, '· 위치 바뀜' per PLAN K2 (session NoteSig via NotePlaceHost + JumpAnchor when the section is laid out; same rule filters refreshQuoteHighlights), hub link '모든 책의 노트' → NotesActivity.open on 북마크/인용문 tabs; TOC title through the kit toolbar (20 sp bold). Pure logic in new QuoteRows with QuoteRowsTest.
checks: module typecheck (--own reader/extras) green; module unittest (ContentsDialog, QuoteRows + 5 lane tests) OK (68 tests); full tools/typecheck.sh green; full tools/unittest.sh OK (1204 tests); stub grep over lane files empty. Note: listing every lane file with --own exceeds the tools' output-dir name length, so typecheck used --own reader/extras (other extras files equal the snapshot).
contractRequests: A host capability to open a quote through the note jump path (ReaderJump.resolve: char-fraction locate + JumpAnchor), e.g. NotePlaceHost.openNote(ReaderJump) or a ReaderPanels interface; ContentsDialog now falls back to PageJumpHost.goToProgress(q.frac), which uses the footer's page measure.

Expose the reader's per-(generation, section) quote-drawn result (PLAN K2) to ContentsDialog, e.g. NotePlaceHost.quotePlaceChanged(q: Quote): Boolean?; ContentsDialog currently recomputes it only for the laid-out section and otherwise uses the sig.
tools/typecheck.sh / unittest.sh: the module-mode output directory is named after all --own paths, which exceeds the filesystem name limit for lanes with many files (hash or truncate TAG).
rcaNotes: Implement NotePlaceHost on ReaderActivity's host (main thread): notePlace(pos).sig = the session NoteSig ('' for EPUB). ContentsDialog.sessionSig(host) calls notePlace(host.currentPosition()) once per quote load/refresh to decide '· 위치 바뀜' and which quotes refreshQuoteHighlights draws.

reloadAnnotations should use the same rule as ContentsDialog.refreshQuoteHighlights / QuoteRows.placeChanged(q.sig, sessionSig, anchorMatch) so a refresh after recolour/delete/save draws the same set (one e-ink update, sameDecor true).
Implement PageJumpHost on the host: ContentsDialog opens a moved quote with goToProgress(q.frac) after dismissing (main thread).

ContentsDialog is still opened by ReaderPanels.showContents(host, tab); the hub link dismisses it and calls NotesActivity.open(ctx, NotesTab.BOOKMARKS/QUOTES); the reader should reloadAnnotations on window focus (existing 1 s guard) to pick up hub recolours.
deviations: Moved quotes open via PageJumpHost.goToProgress(q.frac) instead of the frac + anchor jump path (no host API for it; see contractRequests).
QuoteExport.tagged (EX-S, not in the base) is duplicated as QuoteRows.tagged with the same rule; swap after merge if desired.
With 5 or more chips the chips share the row width (weighted, 4 dp padding) instead of wrap_content, so all fit 360 dp without a smooth-scrolling HorizontalScrollView.
The kit toolbar adds its hairline under the title row (a line between title and tabs that was not there before).
Library.setQuoteStyles is not used in the TOC (no multi-select there; the hub's batch recolour uses it).
